newsitem.title: INDONESIA: No indication Suharto has heart ailment - sources.
newsitem.headline: No indication Suharto has heart ailment - sources.

text.p: Sources close to the Indonesian presidency said on Wednesday night that President Suharto was suffering from a cold and there was no indication that he has a heart ailment.
The sources said rumours about Suharto's health appear to have started on Tuesday evening.

They said he had carried out his official programme on Wednesday at his home rather than from his office in the state palace due to his cold. The Indonesian rupiah weakened briefly on the New York foreign exchange market on Wednesday following offshore response on a Suharto comment on Tuesday about his age.
The Indonesian leader said people who wished to see him stay in office for five more years should consider his age because he will be 77 next year when the presidential election is held.
The rupiah later rebounded against the dollar.
